messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\n\nUsers cannot use keyboard shortcuts when entering data into claim notes, which forces slower manual input and reduces efficiency during busy periods.\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- Calderwick Commercial, an account with 52000.0 GBP in ARR, raised this need through the support route [i:591caf4d5467d5d2].\n- The same account raised the same request again through the support route [i:fd0917cacded3850].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- A user at Calderwick Commercial asked whether there is a way to use keyboard shortcuts in claim notes to speed up data entry, saying it would save them a lot of time during busy periods [i:591caf4d5467d5d2].\n- The identical request was logged again from Calderwick Commercial through the support route [i:fd0917cacded3850].\n- The fact sheet records 1 account, 2 mentions, 1 route, 0 renewals in the next 90 days, and 52000.0 GBP in total ARR as of 2026-11-03 [i:591caf4d5467d5d2].\n\n## Why now\n\n- Calderwick Commercial's renewal date is 2027-09-24, and the fact sheet shows 0 renewals in the next 90 days, so there is no near-term renewal pressure attached to this request [i:fd0917cacded3850].\n- Both mentions came through the support route, and no insight in the fact sheet points the other way [i:591caf4d5467d5d2].\n",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "591caf4d5467d5d2",
   "quote": "I was wondering if there’s a way to use keyboard shortcuts in claim notes to speed up data entry — it’d save us a lot of time during busy periods.",
   "account": "Calderwick Commercial",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-16T11:16:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "id": "fd0917cacded3850",
   "quote": "I was wondering if there’s a way to use keyboard shortcuts in claim notes to speed up data entry — it’d save us a lot of time during busy periods.",
   "account": "Calderwick Commercial",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-16T11:16:00+00:00"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 2,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "support": 2
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 52000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Calderwick Commercial",
    "arr_gbp": 52000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-09-24",
    "mentions": 2
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the ARR figure (52000 GBP), account name, renewal date (2027-09-24), mention counts (2), route counts (support only), and renewals-in-90-days (0) against the fact sheet, and all match. The paraphrased evidence statements accurately reflect the quoted insight about keyboard shortcuts in claim notes, with nothing placed in quotation marks or overstated, and no contrary cited evidence exists. Scope is correctly limited to one account and the support route.", "verdict": "pass"}
